paite: Hichibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; en dih ua, nipithei bawm na hi hi.
heading: Nipithei Bawm Muhna

paite: Ama'n, "Amos, bang ahia na muh?" achi a. Ke'n, "Nipithei bawm," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Ka mi Israelte tung ah tawpna ahong tungta; amaute gawtna ding ah ka lungsim ka kheng nawn kei ding hi, chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in tempul a lasakte dahna la ahi ding a; mun chih ah siluang tampi a-om ding a, dai dide in apaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
Hiai ngaikhia in, aw tasamte ne bei nuam a; gam a migentheite hihmang nuamte aw,
heading: Israel Tunggikna

paite: "Buh ka zuaktheihna ding un chikchiang a kha thak bei ding a, tangbuang buh ka zuaktheihna ding ua chikchiang a Sabbath ni bei ding ahia, chi in; Ephah hihneu a shekel hihlian, dikloupi a bukna khemna in na zang ua,
huchi a dangkasik a migentheite lei a, tasamte khedap buh khat a i lei a, buhsi i zuaktheihna ding in,” chi in.
TOUPA, Jakob thupina sial in akichiam a, “Pel lou in anasep himhim ka mangngilh het kei ding," chi in.
Hiai ziak in gam pumpi ling in asung a om peuhmahte alungkham kei ding ua hia? Ahi, tui lian bang in ahong khang vek ding a; Aigupta gam lui bang in ahong buai in akiam ding hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in, hichi ahong hi ding a, sun lai in ni ka tumsak ding a, nisat lai in lei ka mialsak ding hi.

Na ankuangluite uh lungkhamna leh na la tengteng uh kahna ka suaksak ding a; kawng tengteng sai-ip puan ka tengsak ding a, lu chih sip ah giauna ka hon tungsak ding; tapa tang neih suunna ding in lungkhamna leh atawpna khatna ni bang in ka bawl ding hi.
“Toupa PATHIAN in, ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung lellel; huai ni chiang in gam ah kial ka sawl ding a, an kialna hilou, tui a kialna hi sam lou, TOUPA thu theihna kialna pen," achi hi.
Huan tuipi a kipan tuipi ah leh mal a kipan suahlam ah leng avakvai ding ua; TOUPA thu zong ding in ning chih ah atai ding ua, amu kei ding uh.
Huai ni chiang in nungak siangthou leh tangvalte dangtak in abah ding uhi.
"Samaria khelhna sial a kichiam a, 'Aw Dan, na Pathian ahin bang in' leh 'Beer-sheba Lampi ahin bang in' chi, huai mite leng apuk ding ua, athounawn het kei ding uh,” achi hi.
